Our Case Studies

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="What kind of work is shown in these case studies?" tab_id="faq-cases-1-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Data visualization and storytelling projects — dashboards, reports, infographics and training engagements — spanning Australia, the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Asia.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can we see work for organisations like ours?" tab_id="faq-cases-2-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

The case studies cover corporate, government and broadcast clients. Where a client is under NDA the work is described without naming them, which is why some studies are less specific than others.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What usually starts one of these projects?" tab_id="faq-cases-3-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Most begin one of two ways: a team that cannot get its reporting read, or a team that wants to build the skill in-house. The second is what the training workshops exist for.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Who does the work?" tab_id="faq-cases-4-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

The Datalabs Agency is a Melbourne-based data visualization consultancy founded in 2012 that delivers corporate training workshops (Power BI, Tableau, data storytelling), dashboard design, and BI style guides for clients including Mercedes-Benz, Adidas, and UPS.
